newsitem.title: FRANCE: Nice air cargo traffic up 12.6pct in Dec 96.
newsitem.headline: Nice air cargo traffic up 12.6pct in Dec 96.

text.p: Nice-Cote d'Azur airport reported a 12.6 percent increase in airfreight traffic in December 1996 on the same month in 1995 with throughput reaching 1,782 tonnes, airport authority figures showed.
International freight traffic was up 30 percent last month on December 1995 reaching 692 tonnes.

"Since the introduction of winter 96/97 airline schedules from end-October 1996, passenger aircraft movements at Nice hs risen by around 50 percent on the 95/96 winter season and this has had a knock-on effect on airfreight," an airport authority official told Reuters.
Nice airport's 1996 cargo totalled 18,103 tonnes, down 4.4 percent on 1995 levels.
The Air France group generates the major part of "bellyhold" cargo traffic at Nice airport.
Express operators, United Parcel Service and DHL Worldwide Express operate scheduled feeder flights to and from Nice as part of their intra-European air cargo network.
1996 postal traffic was up 14.3 percent on 1995 levels at 8,825 tonnes.

French airline, L'Aeropostale, carries overnight mail between its Paris-Charles de Gaulle hub and Nice on a regular basis using Boeing 737QC aircraft. - Reuters Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax+542-5017
